A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a system of biological oscillators, which are coupled in a specific manner, will synchronize and entrain in a manner similar to that of a system of mathematical oscillators.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the mathematical models for the biological systems are not as important as the mathematical models for oscillators in general.
the mathematical models of biological oscillators are sufficiently accurate to be able to explain phenomena observed in biological systems.
the behaviour of biological oscillators can be understood as a result of a combination of the properties of individual oscillators and the properties of the coupling mechanism.
